---
title: "Partners and related initiatives"
---

::: {.lede}
Where to find support and learn from others running experiments: related initiatives
across the European Commission, and established research groups that can provide
outside technical support alongside EuroCOMP Lab.
:::

## Related European Commission initiatives

Experimentation is gaining ground across the European Commission, not only in Cohesion Policy.

:::: {.cards}
::: {.card-e}
#### [Policy experimentation in research and innovation](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/strategy/support-policy-making/shaping-eu-research-and-innovation-policy/policy-experimentation-research-and-innovation_en)
The Directorate General Research and Innovation's work on testing research and innovation policies before
scaling them up, including an interactive map of policy-experimentation organisations
across EU Member States and an emerging Community of Practice.
:::
::::

## International research partners

Established labs and research groups already running rigorous impact evaluations.

:::: {.cards}
::: {.card-e}
#### [J-PAL](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/)
The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab specialises in impact evaluation design.
:::
::: {.card-e}
#### [IPA](https://poverty-action.org/)
Innovations for Poverty Action designs and rigorously evaluates solutions to poverty.
:::
::: {.card-e}
#### [World Bank DIME](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/unit-dec/impactevaluation/about)
The World Bank's Development Impact Evaluation group.
:::
::: {.card-e}
#### [International Initiative for Impact Evaluation (3ie)](https://www.3ieimpact.org/)
A global non-profit research organisation collaborating with decision-makers in governments, foundations, NGOs, development and research organizations globally.
:::
::::

::: {.card-e}
